exposure: severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection
cohort: Unvaccinated pregnant or immediately postpartum women hospitalized with severe COVID-19 (n=26)
finding: Unvaccinated pregnant women with severe COVID-19 infection requiring ICU admission have a high mortality rate (34.62%) and are at increased risk for adverse outcomes such as preterm birth and stillbirth.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in 79.17% of the patients who delivered.
